exotic_armor.name: Shards of Galanor
exotic_armor.description: Throwing Knife final blows decrease the cooldown of your Super. Hitting a single target with most Blade Barrage knives in a volley causes them to release a violent Solar explosion, releasing scorching Solar shrapnel. Hits and final blows with Blade Barrage return Super energy after the Super ends.
exotic_armor.community_insight:
• Throwing Knife Kills grant 2.5–5% Super Energy depending on enemy rank.
• Passively increases Blade Barrage impact and explosive damage by 25%.
• Landing 5 Blade Barrage knives triggers a Solar Detonation (up to 2 per cast).
• Each Detonation deals significant damage across a 10m radius with no falloff and releases 4 Scorching Shrapnel applying 20 Scorch each (unaffected by Ember of Ashes).
• Detonations & shrapnel deal ~35% reduced damage to Boss-Tier combatants and are not buffed by Super Stat.
• Blade Barrage hits and kills refund up to a maximum of 50% Super energy.
• Overall increase to Blade Barrage damage against Boss combatants is roughly ~140%!

stat_priority: 150+ Weapon & Super stat (200 is best), at least 100 Class stat, 0 Health, low Melee and Grenade (not a key part of the build).
ghost_mod: Powerhouse (Recommended to get close to target stat splits)

title: Arc Warlock Chaos Reach Infinite Super & Ad Clear (Geomag Stabilizers)
grenade: User's choice (Pulse or Storm Grenade recommended)

weapons.heavy: One Thousand Voices or Thunderlord (Thunderlord is very easy to get and still very, very good)
weapons.energy: Arc weapon with Jolting Feedback & Voltshot (e.g. Chrysura Melo from 'The Shattered Throne' dungeon - easiest dungeon in the game)

artifact.name: Tablet of Ruin (especially if using 1K or fusion alongside)

armor_set.name: Luminopotent Set (Fireteam Ops or focus from Zavala)
armor_set.bonus_4pc: 4-Piece Set Bonus: 'Shock and Clear' — Final blows with Jolt or against Jolted combatants create Ionic Traces which fund your Super.

exotic_armor.name: Geomag Stabilizers
exotic_armor.description: Damaging targets with Chaos Reach extends its duration. Collecting Ionic Traces grants you energy for Chaos Reach. Sprinting while near max Bolt Charge will grant stacks over time.
exotic_armor.community_insight:
• Collecting Ionic Traces grants 4% Chaos Reach Super Energy.
• While at 5 Stacks of Bolt Charge or higher, after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds, maintaining sprint grants a Stack of Bolt Charge every 0.33 seconds.
• Chaos Reach refunds 10% Super Energy on hit (0.75s cooldown between refunds).
• This can increase Chaos Reach beam duration by up to ~120%!

stat_priority: 150+ Grenade and Super stats, 50+ Class and Weapons, 0 Health and Melee are not really used (unless you find yourself doing more melee than grenades).
ghost_mod: Grenadier, Powerhouse, or Demolitionist (Recommended for these stats)

class_ability: User's choice (Overwritten by Icefall Mantle Glacial Guard)

armor_set.name: Seventh Seraph Set (Cosmodrome Public Events / Master Lost Sectors for easy T5) OR Exodus Down Set (Nessus Public Events / Master Lost Sectors for easy T5)
armor_set.bonus_4pc: High Tier-5 armor set providing maximum stat allocation and resilience thresholds.

exotic_armor.name: Icefall Mantle
exotic_armor.description: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, rapid Stasis final blows grant Frost Armor. You heal a small amount whenever you gain Frost Armor. Replaces your class ability with a burst of Stasis energy that freezes nearby combatants, slows nearby opponents, and grants you increased Frost Armor.
exotic_armor.community_insight:
• Requires a Stasis Super Ability to be equipped.
• Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to a unique, faster 70-second base cooldown (~30 seconds at 100 Class Stat).
• Scoring 2 Stasis Kills within 3 seconds of each grants a Stack of Frost Armor.
• Restores 10 HP for each Stack of Frost Armor you gain from any source.
• Replaces Barricade with Glacial Guard (does not work with Thruster).
• On Glacial Guard Cast: Grants maximum Frost Armor Stacks (restoring HP for each stack gained) and applies 100 Slow (40 in PVP) to nearby combatants.

legs: 1x Solar Weapon Surge (or Kinetic Surge if using Fighting Lion)

stat_priority: 100+ Weapon, Super, and Melee stat. Health, Grenade, and Class are user's choice (those stats don't really matter for this loop).
